decisions.reason: The existing message-143 FAQ Event already represents the commission trigger, amount, immediacy, wallet delivery, and unlimited earning claim.
The commission clarification does not change prize-ticket issuance, and the candidate already specifies the successful code-used mint trigger, recipient, and ticket quantities.
Clarifying who receives a code-used commission does not alter the mint-number basis, permanence, sharing, display, or resale behavior of the referral code.
The source decision governs commission payments when a referral code is used and does not change ticket allocation for mints without a referral code.

The candidate already records the $5 allocation for a code-used mint; commission recipient, wallet destination, timing, and earning limit belong to the separate commission Requirement and do not change the revenue split.
The commission clarification does not change any metadata counter, badge, or referral-code attribute displayed on the NFT.
Commission payout semantics do not alter badge milestones, award conditions, or on-chain badge recording.
The source commission decision does not change Big Block prize amounts, draw timing, eligibility, ticket reset, or pool funding.
The source commission decision does not change Small Block prize amounts, sales interval, eligible tickets, reset behavior, or pool funding.
Commission trigger and payout details do not affect the random winner-selection method, eligible population, provider, or verification method.
The code-used commission clarification does not change which NFT entitlements, referral identity, badges, or expired-ticket state transfer on resale.
Automatic wallet delivery of referral commissions is distinct from the manual one-click claim flow for prize winnings and leaves that flow unchanged.
